purpose: Cover US-17802 (validate findings): the four new findings on an interface kind outside the vocabulary, a bracketed AC prefix outside the known classes, a tacIds naming a non-TAC and an unresolving ownerRef or deliveredBy; the dogfood tree is clean; and absence of a class marker is NOT a finding (decision 10, kept).
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: rcf define validate findings

testCases.description: A TAC with an interface { kind: 'widget' } fails rcf define validate with a defineValidate:interfaceKind finding naming the TAC id, the interface name and the unknown kind; the exit code is 3.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/validate-findings.test.js::validate findings (PR 8, AC-17802-1): interface kind outside the vocabulary is a finding

testCases.description: An AC with description '[sometimes] ...' fails rcf define validate with a defineValidate:acClassPrefix finding naming the US id, the AC id and the unknown prefix.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/validate-findings.test.js::validate findings (PR 8, AC-17802-2): bracketed AC prefix outside the known classes is a finding

testCases.description: A US with tacIds naming a non-TAC fires defineValidate:tacIdsResolves; an AC with ownerRef { tacId, field } that does not resolve fires defineValidate:ownerRefResolves; a REQ with deliveredBy pointing at a dangling id fires defineValidate:deliveredByResolves. Each exits 3.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/validate-findings.test.js::validate findings (PR 8): tacIds, ownerRef and deliveredBy each produce a finding

testCases.description: rcf define validate on the rcf-lite dogfood tree exits 0 (no new findings; no legacy finding is widened).
